map.Naegele法则：预产期 = 末次月经 + 280天(40周)，推算孕期节点与: Naegele rule: EDD = LMP + 280 days (40 weeks), used to estimate pregnancy milestones and prenatal-visit timing
map.已知预产期反推 LMP，核对孕周记录。: Given a due date, back-compute LMP to verify gestational-age records.
map.早筛建档时由 EDD 回填 LMP 推算受孕窗口。: When building an early-screening record, back-fill LMP from EDD to infer the conception window.
map.月经周期非 28 天同步校正。: Menstrual cycle not 28 days: synchronized correction.
map.：EDD 2026-10-08、周期 28 天：LMP = EDD − 280: : EDD 2026-10-08, cycle 28 days: LMP = EDD - 280 days = 2026-01-01, conception day about 2026-01-15.
map.：EDD 2026-10-15、周期 35 天：LMP = EDD − 280: : EDD 2026-10-15, cycle 35 days: LMP = EDD - 280 - (35-28) = 2026-01-01, earlier LMP than the short cycle.
map.反推和正推结果为何要一致？: Why should back-computation and forward computation agree?
map.EDD→LMP 与 LMP→EDD 是互逆运算，都应回到同一受孕窗口；若超声孕周: EDD->LMP and LMP->EDD are inverse operations and should return the same conception window; if the ultrasound gestational age differs from the back-computed LMP age by more than 7 days, the EDD should be corrected by ultrasound.
map.周期长度怎么影响？: How does cycle length affect it?
map.周期每比 28 天多 1 天，EDD 后延 1 天、LMP 相应前移 1 天，保: For each day the cycle exceeds 28, the EDD shifts later by 1 day and the LMP shifts earlier by 1 day, keeping total length 280 + (cycle - 28) days unchanged.
